question: How much do driving lessons in Amsterdam cost at Rijschool All Drive?
answer: A 60-minute lesson costs {lessonPrice}. Packages including the CBR practical exam start at {fromPrice} for {fromLessons} lessons. See all packages on the prices page.

question: How many driving lessons do I need?
answer: At Rijschool All Drive, students need on average {min} to {max} lessons, depending on their experience. That is why our packages have 20, 30 or 40 lessons. After the trial lesson you get lesson advice.

question: How long is a driving lesson?
answer: Our packages are based on 60-minute lessons. Most students choose lessons of 1.5 hours on average, at their own request. Would you like shorter or longer lessons? We are flexible and happy to adapt.

question: Automatic or manual: what can I choose?
answer: Both. We teach in a manual or automatic car (licence B). With a manual licence you may drive both types of car; with an automatic licence only automatics.

question: Is the CBR practical exam included in the price?
answer: Yes, packages marked ‘Incl. exam’ include the CBR practical exam. On its own, a practical exam costs {examPrice}.

question: How much does an extra lesson cost?
Will I be picked up?
answer: Yes. Your instructor picks you up and drops you off after every lesson, in Amsterdam and the towns in our service area.

question: Can I have lessons in the evening or on Saturdays?
answer: Yes, by arrangement we also schedule lessons in the evening and on Saturdays.

question: I have driving anxiety. Can I still take lessons?
answer: Yes. Tell us during the trial lesson. We discuss your concerns and build up the lessons step by step, at your own pace, with a dedicated instructor.

question: Do you guide students to a fear of failure exam?
answer: Yes. If you are too nervous for the regular practical exam, you can take a fear of failure exam (faalangstexamen) with the CBR. We prepare you and book the exam for you.

question: What is a BNOR exam?
answer: A BNOR exam (Bureau Nader Onderzoek Rijvaardigheid, also called the state exam) is a CBR practical exam for people who failed their regular driving test 4 times within 5 years. At Rijschool All Drive a BNOR exam costs {bnorPrice}.

question: How soon can I have a trial lesson?
answer: You can usually start within a few weeks. Send us a WhatsApp message and we will let you know when there is a spot. The trial lesson is free when you buy a package.

question: Do you offer an intensive driving course?
answer: Yes. In an intensive course you take many lessons in a short time. The price depends on your situation; request one via WhatsApp or call us.

question: Do you teach in English?
answer: Yes. We teach in English and in Dutch.
